summary: Official Thai Department of Lands discovery and the current LandsPublic viewer were reviewed. The viewer exposes a public-land NSL layer and anonymous APIs, but the exact WUP point and a bounded city-area WFS request returned no public-land features. No complete private cadastral parcel source or safe polygon sample was qualified.
custodian: Department of Lands is the national service custodian; the Phitsanulok Provincial Land Office is the local DOL office. The public-land NSL layer is not treated as a complete private cadastral registry.
requests: English and Thai discovery queries, viewer/configuration inspection, exact-point API request, WFS/WMS capability requests, schema request, and bounded WFS request are recorded in the city record. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/public-land identifier only if source-proven
full polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The WUP point [16.812077346364, 100.254071434807] and population 189643 persons are preserved.
The exact-point HTTP 404 and bounded empty WFS response concern only the exposed public-land route and are not citywide absence evidence.
A legacy DOLWMS discovery URL was unavailable from this environment; no TLS exception or bypass was attempted.
No unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: A supported authenticated or separate interactive DOL cadastral workflow may expose additional parcel data, but it was outside anonymous safe research scope.
No current private-parcel identity, geometry response, or citywide cadastral coverage was qualified.
